definition: Add to an open position after the price has moved against it, so its average entry price improves and a smaller move back reaches break-even.
boundaries: Known failure: a falling price may be a warning, not a bargain, and each add makes the same wrong idea bigger. It differs from scale-in, which adds to a winner. Named so a unit, a source or he can point at it; its maths is the risk session's.
recognition: The trader buys more as the price keeps falling below the first entry.

sources.quote: adding to an existing position when its price drops
a warning signal that prices are about to go much lower
